title: Hard to get started
body: As a beginner I find it very confusing, there’s so much going on, so many pop up messages, so many boxes to read and or to click on in so many colors. It’s overwhelming for someone who used to use more simplified systems, who doesn’t want to spend more than five minutes in the app. Sometimes it’s frustrating to have to read and or listen to all the pop up’s just to check a box (I know it can be skipped but still). I think it’s overdone and over complicated.
